items.title: Pushing forward powers of the first Chern class of the tautological bundle on a projective bundle
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pushforward along a projective bundle of the self-caps of c_1(O_P(1)) applied to a pulled back cycle: it is zero in degrees below r - 1 and returns the original class in degree r - 1 (statement lines 6867-6883, tag 02TW). The proof needs a real construction for the critical degree: after shrinking the base by a proper closed subset it chooses elements of the fibre of E at the generic point extending to part of a basis, builds rational sections of O_P(1) whose common zero set is the image of a section of the bundle, and then iterates the geometric case of capping with a first Chern class to identify the successive caps with the cycle classes of these zero sets. The iteration and the section construction are the substance, so the claim is H2.
